name: These Aren't the Droids You're Looking For
aka: These Aren't The Droids You Were Looking For
look: A widescreen still from the original Star Wars. Obi-Wan Kenobi (Alec Guinness), in a brown hooded robe, calmly waves his fingers in a Jedi mind trick from a landspeeder, with R2-D2 and C-3PO behind him and the back of Luke's head in the foreground.
use: Obi-Wan smoothly talks someone out of noticing something. Captions are a calm, hand-waving dismissal meant to make a person overlook a problem, usually in the form "These aren't the ___ you're looking for."
slots: bottom: these aren't the ___ you're looking for
examples: When mom asks who ate the last slice of cake
This isn't the crumb trail you're looking for
Showing my boss the project timeline
These aren't the deadlines you're looking for
describe: obi wan waving his hand to trick a guard
old jedi in a hood waving at a stormtrooper with droids behind him
alec guinness hand gesture telling someone to move along
star wars scene in the landspeeder with r2d2 and c3po
bearded man in a brown hood waving his fingers to control minds
origin: From the original 1977 Star Wars, when Obi-Wan uses a Jedi mind trick on stormtroopers in Mos Eisley: "These aren't the droids you're looking for."
